messages.subject: Mitochondrial Markers
parts:
Hello everyone,
I am running a QTL and I want to see if there are mitochondrial/
autosomal interactions. Do I need to code the mitochondrial markers
specially? If so how? I looked in the group and in the book but I
couldn't find anything.

Thanks,
Emma

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Mitochondrial Markers
parts:
It depends on the cross, but often mitochondria genotype would be confounded with cross direction and also Y chromosome. To investigate QTL x mitochondrial interactions, you'd include a covariate indicating cross and look for a QTL x covariate interaction.

karl
